caveats: Experimental: requires Paseo 0.9.0-beta.1, Node >=22.19, and configured MaKa; signed Desktop/CLI dev39 tested.
Keep Desktop/CLI compatible: dev40 needs schema 19, unsupported by dev39 Desktop; dev40 only passed isolated protocol checks.

Standard ACP tool cards are supported when MaKa emits them; published .41/.42 include the mapper, but real .42 tool execution was not observed in the isolated profile. No MCP forwarding, interactive approvals, or usage updates.
Connected follow-ups work; importing or reopening sessions after reload/restart is unavailable.
Uses MaKa's configured default model and permissions; Paseo custom system prompts/tool policy are not applied.
Verified on macOS; real MaKa on Windows/Linux and native mobile UI remain unverified.
